title: Restock a twin jumbo-roll tissue dispenser: stub to the reserve spindle, new roll on the primary, cover locked
instruction: This dispenser is almost empty. Restock it with the new roll so the old one gets used up first, and lock it.
context: Restocking restroom dispensers is a core task of janitors and cleaners (O*NET 37-2011.00; 2,172,500 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023). On a twin jumbo-roll dispenser the nearly used stub is moved to the reserve spindle so it is finished first, the new roll goes on the primary, and the changeover shutter is set so tissue comes from the stub; each sprung hub only lets a core on or off while its release button is held, and the cover only closes once its stay is released. The instruction says none of this.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), heights above the bench top. Dispenser in its normal wall orientation on a vertical board (2 x 56 cm, 26.8 cm tall) at x 40.6-42.6. White back plate 49 (y) x 26.4 (tall) x 0.6 cm, front face at x 40, 0.4 to 26.8 cm up, with a 3 cm rim (0.4 cm walls) out to x 37. Two horizontal spindles 14.25 cm up, pointing -x: primary at y 12, reserve at y -12. Each is a grey split hub (40 g) on a bearing boss on the plate, turning freely (drag 0.01 N*m*s/rad, brake 0.03 N*m): a fixed upper lug 2.9 (x) x 2.4 x 1.5 cm, 2.25-3.75 cm above the axis, and a sprung lower lug 2.9 x 2.4 x 1.1 cm (20 g, 500 N/m), 3.25-4.35 cm below it at rest, 4.8 cm upward travel; both lugs run from x 37.05 to 39.95. Bottom lip in front: white 3.8 x 33 x 1.6 cm box at x 15, y -24 to 9. On it, three blue buttons on grey bases 1 cm tall: primary release 3.2 cm square (1.2 cm tall, 20 g, 400 N/m, 6 mm travel) at y -5.5, reserve release (same) at y -22.5, stay release 1.6 cm square at y 0. A release button pressed 4 mm or more draws its hub's sprung lug in. Stub: 12-sided paper ring, 8.3 cm across, 7.5 cm core, 9 cm long, 150 g, on the primary hub. New roll: 23 cm across, 7.5 cm core, 9 cm long, 0.9 kg, lying axis along x, front end at x 26, centred y 42, on a cardboard carton 11 x 20 x 7.2 cm at x 30.5, y 42. Cover: smoked shell 49 x 26.4 x 7.4 cm deep, 0.5 kg, hinged along the rim's top front edge (x 37, 26.8 cm up), closing spring 0.2 N*m/rad and 3 N*m*s/rad damper; it starts swung up to 170 deg, held by a stay. Its front panel has two outlet windows 3 to 8.5 cm above its bottom edge: reserve y -20 to -4, primary y 4 to 20. Changeover shutter: red plate 17 x 6.3 x 0.3 cm (30 g) with a 6 x 1.2 x 2 cm thumb tab, sliding along the outside of the panel, detents over the reserve window (as found) and 24 cm toward +y over the primary window; past half way it snaps to the far detent (60 N/m). Waste bin: dark 11 x 11 x 5 cm open box at x 9, y 22.
scoring: Seated: core back end within 3 mm of the plate face, its axis within 12 mm of the spindle axis and within 3 deg of it. A core is engaged only if its hub's sprung lug was drawn in (button held) while the core was within 4 cm of the axis and its back end within 4 cm of the plate, and the lug now presses on the core (0.3 to 3.6 cm in). Points: stub seated and engaged on the reserve hub with its axis within 6 mm of the spindle axis 0.25; only with that: new roll seated and engaged on the primary 0.25; with both: cover shut (under 1 deg) and latched (the latch clicks under 1.5 deg) 0.25; with that: shutter at the far detent (within 1 cm), primary window covered and the stub's window open 0.15; then no gripper within 2 cm of either roll, a button or the shutter, rolls and cover still (under 1 cm/s, 0.25 rad/s) 0.10. Score 0 if the run ends with the stub outside the dispenser, or the new roll on the reserve and the stub on the primary. Score 0, latched, if the cover is slammed (still closing at over 6 rad/s within 15 deg of shut, an edge speed over 1.8 m/s; spring and damper alone close it at under 1 rad/s), a roll falls 5 cm below the bench, the stub goes into the bin, or the cover comes down within 45 deg onto a core inside it that is not seated. Scored at the last step; 1.0 held for 1 s ends the run.
reset_notes: Open the latch and swing the cover up onto its stay. Holding each release button, take the new roll off the primary and the stub off the reserve; put the stub back on the primary (button held) and lay the new roll on its carton at its mark. Slide the shutter back over the reserve window.
fidelity: Rigid boxes; rolls are 12-sided rings. Hubs turn on free revolute joints; a release button draws its sprung lug in by a rule, not a linkage. The stub starts welded to its hub until the primary button is pressed. Stay and latch are pre-made disabled joints switched by rules. Shutter detents are a sprung slide driven to the nearer detent. Tissue sheets are not simulated: the windows and shutter are geometry.
